intent: A dark, monochrome share panel: emails become validated chips, roles live in a compact menu, removals offer Undo, link access steps from restricted to public, and Copy link morphs into a tick.

stack.styling: Tailwind CSS v4 with @container queries; colour tokens as CSS variables on the root; color-mix() for tints
stack.animation: motion/react: AnimatePresence for chips, rows, menus and swaps; layoutId for the menu highlight; layout='position' for rows
stack.icons: lucide-react (AlertCircle, Building2, Check, ChevronDown, Globe, Link2, Lock, X)
stack.fonts: font-display (Geist) for the heading, font-sans (Geist) for UI, font-mono (Geist Mono) for labels and tags

layout.card: surface, 1px line, 14px radius, inset highlight + deep shadow; no overflow hidden so menus can float out; 600px max in the demo
layout.header: ‘Share “Q4 launch plan”’ in display 18px, mono people count right
layout.inviteRow: sunken wrapping field (chips + input + quiet role trigger) and a 44px accent Invite button; stacks below @md
layout.hintLine: 12px hint, or the first problem in danger
layout.people: 32px avatar (dashed ring when pending), name + (you) + GUEST tag, email or pending note, role menu (Owner is plain text)
layout.footer: Undo bar when needed; GENERAL ACCESS: 36px icon tile, level menu, ‘· can view’ menu when open, consequence line, fixed-width Copy link
layout.menus: 256–288px popover listbox; label + hint per option; accent ✓ on selected; Remove access under a hairline in danger; footer menus open upward

color.approach: greyscale; one accent prop for the primary button, selected checks and the Copied tick; danger only for invalid chips and removal
color.onAccent: black or white, computed from the accent's relative luminance

motion.order: card → header → invite row → section label → rows 50ms apart from 0.24s → footer
motion.chips: commit on , ; space Enter Tab, paste or blur; 0.9→1 scale with 3px blur (0.2s); Backspace removes the last
motion.invite: valid chips become pending rows that rise in; invalid chips stay with the error
motion.remove: row collapses (height, padding, 4px blur, 0.28s); Undo bar unfolds with a draining hairline over undoMs
motion.menus: 6px offset, 0.98 scale, 4px blur (0.2s); highlight slides on spring 500/40
motion.copy: label rolls to ‘✓ Copied’ for 1.6s at fixed width

responsive.320: Invite button under the field; long names and emails truncate
responsive.768+: Invite beside the field; menus anchored to their trigger

accessibility: menu triggers: aria-haspopup=listbox, aria-expanded, aria-label naming the person
listbox options with ↑/↓, Enter/Space, Esc, Tab; close on outside press
email input: aria-invalid and aria-describedby on the live hint/error line
chip remove buttons labelled with the address

content.people: Hana Sato (owner, you), Mateo Herrera (can edit), Jonas Weber (can comment), Elif Demir from studio-demir.com (guest, can view)
content.linkLevels: Restricted · Anyone at Northwind · Anyone with the link, each with a one-line consequence

avoid: a Copy button that changes width
overflow hidden on the card (it clips the menus)
